description: Room state read and closing the room at the end of a meeting.

preconditions: Online meeting just ended; its room session is still open.
cases.return: The provider room "meeting-{id}" is deleted; the open session is ended at the time the provider confirms closure (never earlier than any recorded join or leave). Open visits are closed with it.
Returns at once; nothing is deleted and no session is touched.

preconditions: Online meeting just ended; the provider room exists but the database never heard anyone in (no active session).
cases.return: The provider room "meeting-{id}" is still deleted; with no session there is nothing to end and no session is created.
